festivals: Tuesdays and Saturdays (weekly Bada Mangal crowds)

history.summary: A major Hanuman shrine on the Gomti riverbank at Hanuman Setu, University Road, established by the saint Neem Karoli Baba in the early 1960s; an ashram is attached. One of Lucknow's most visited temples, thronged on Tuesdays. Opening-hours sources conflict: 6 AM–1 PM / 3 PM–10 PM vs 5 AM–11 PM — verify before visit.

name: Hanuman Setu Temple
town_description: Lucknow is the capital of Uttar Pradesh on the Gomti river, famed for its Nawabi heritage — Awadhi cuisine, chikankari embroidery, the Bara and Chhota Imambaras, and a lively old-city culture of tehzeeb and poetry.

travel.airport: Chaudhary Charan Singh International Airport (~13 km)
travel.road: Hanuman Setu, University Road, Hasanganj — city buses, autos and cabs

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Tuesdays are the busiest day
visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00 AM–1:00 PM, 3:00–10:00 PM per one listing; conflicting sources list 5:00 AM–11:00 PM — verify before visit
